# Dick

## Overview

- **Gender:** male (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** alive (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P33](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0033), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P30](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0030)</sub>
- **Family:** [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) (cousin), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Dick is a big man who was once considered handsome, though he later became badly gone to fat with a broad, round, red face, vacant eyes, and a big beard. He features a higher color than George, hair that is a shade lighter, and a distinctive pair of eyes, one blue and one hazel.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Dick is a large, handsome man who is mentally deficient, easily controlled, and mostly good-humored, harmless, and good-natured. Beneath his vacant exterior, however, he possesses a little, ugly soul.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P3](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P23](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0023), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P30](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0030)_

## History

Dick originally spent his summers sailing and his winters clerking in his father's store before he died of yellow fever in Cuba thirteen years prior. After he went missing, his cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md)—who had suffered a brain injury that caused severe memory loss—was mistaken for Dick and brought home by Captain Jim. This man lived with Dick's wife, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), on the West place through the winter, until [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) suggested a surgical operation in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) to relieve the pressure on his brain. Following the successful surgery, it was revealed that the man was not Dick at all, but his cousin George.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P0](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P5](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P7](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0007), +9 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dick.md)

Dick takes a strong liking to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), following her around like a dog. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) to Dick and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) at their house, and she later worries about Leslie's future happiness when an operation is proposed to restore Dick's mental state.

### [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--george-moore.md)

Dick is the cousin of [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), with whom he served as a shipmate on a sea voyage to [Havana](../codex/places.md#havana). It is later discovered following a surgical procedure in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) that the man long believed to be Dick is actually [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md).

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--leslie-moore.md)

Dick is married to [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), who cares for him despite the emotional burden it places on her. When [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) suggests a medical procedure that might cure Dick, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) finances and undertakes a trip to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for his surgery, only to discover afterward that the man she believed to be her husband is actually his cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), +19 more_

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--uncle-jim.md)

Captain Jim rescues and brings Dick home to [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). He later supports telling [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) about a potential surgical operation for Dick, which ultimately leads to the discovery of Dick's true identity.
